description: This file defines the NotesController class, which manages note data, handles user interactions, and synchronizes with a backend repository in a Flutter application.

classes.name: NotesController
classes.description: A class extending ChangeNotifier that manages the state of notes, including loading, editing, deleting, and synchronizing notes with a backend repository.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the controller by loading notes and starting a periodic sync.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads notes from local storage with current filters.

methods.name: setSearch
methods.description: Sets the search string and applies debounce before refreshing notes.

methods.name: setTagFilter
methods.description: Sets the current tag filter and refreshes notes.

methods.name: createNewNote
methods.description: Creates a new empty note with a unique ID.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its local ID.

methods.name: saveNote
methods.description: Saves a note locally and initiates a sync.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Performs soft delete on a note and syncs.

methods.name: computeAllTags
methods.description: Aggregates all unique tags from current notes.

methods.name: _setBusy
methods.description: Updates busy state and notifies listeners.

methods.name: _setError
methods.description: Updates error message and notifies listeners.
